summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests how well a radioactive imaging tracer called fluorine F 18 fluorthanatrace works with PET/CT scans in people with solid tumors, including breast, ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal cancers. Patients get FDG through an IV and a FDG PET/CT scan over 20 to 30 minutes if they have not had one as standard care, then at least 20 to 24 hours later get fluorine F 18 fluorthanatrace through an IV and a PET/CT scan over 1 hour. The record does not state a main outcome measure; the study is Phase 1.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa qué tan bien funciona un trazador radiactivo de imagen llamado fluorine F 18 fluorthanatrace con estudios PET/TC en personas con tumores sólidos, como cáncer de mama, de ovario, de trompa de Falopio y peritoneal primario. Los pacientes reciben FDG por vía intravenosa y se les hace una PET/TC con FDG de 20 a 30 minutos, si no la han tenido como parte de su atención estándar; al menos 20 a 24 horas después reciben fluorine F 18 fluorthanatrace por vía intravenosa y una PET/TC de 1 hora. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase 1.
who_for: Has a known or suspected solid tumor.
Has at least one lesion 1.0 cm or larger seen on standard imaging such as CT, MRI, ultrasound, or FDG PET/CT.
not_for: Is pregnant or breastfeeding at screening.
Cannot tolerate imaging procedures, in the opinion of an investigator or treating physician.
Has a medical condition that a physician investigator considers could compromise safety or successful participation.
